The '''Time-Space Axis''' (Japanese: '''時空儀''' ''Time-Space Projector'') is a device featured in the {{pkmn|movie}} ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'', used to monitor disruptions in the {{wp|Spacetime|time-space continuum}}. It is located in the basement of the {{DL|Michina Town|Michina Ruins}}.

It can indicate the condition of every minute change in the time-space continuum, serving to mirror the movements of the timespace [[dimension]]s and thus monitoring the likelihood of potential cataclysm. It is currently under the supervision of [[Sheena]] and {{OBP|Kevin|M12}}, who use it to investigate locations where time-space gets distorted and to predict the moment in which {{OBP|Arceus|M12}} will wake up from its deep slumber.

==History==
After observing unusual movements in the Time-Space Axis, Sheena and Kevin traveled around the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] to see the catastrophes resulting from time-space distortions. They were near the plateau of [[Alamos Town]] when {{mov|Palkia}} returned it to the correct dimension at the end of ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]''. They also visited the glacier near [[Ten'i Village]] to see [[Zero]]'s [[Megarig|airship]] after it crashed during the climax of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''.

During their tour of the Michina Ruins, {{Ash}}, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{an|Brock}} were taken to see the Time-Space Axis. Sheena explained to them that at the bottom of the device is the [[Pokémon world]], which is supported by {{mov|Giratina}}'s [[Reverse World]]. Near the top of the Axis are the dimensions of {{mov|Dialga}} and Palkia while Arceus's world is located at the center.
